# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen years old (by Volume 3)  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring poet  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has an exceptionally delicate, refined, and beautiful face framed in a halo of chestnut curls, which he later cuts short into close-cropped brown locks. He has dark blue eyes that match his father's, and a crimson-lipped, expressive mouth with finely turned corners. By sixteen, he has grown tall, manly, and sturdy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c18 P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v3 c19 P25](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0025), [v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Paul is a grave, meditative, and highly imaginative boy with an intense love of beauty, romance, and poetry. Though deeply sensitive and dreamily inclined to invent imaginary 'rock people,' he is also manly and brave, holding his own at school games. He possesses a rare, illuminative smile and a deep capacity for affection and loyalty. He is thoughtful and fair-minded, seeking truth and understanding in his relationships with others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c15 P48](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0048), [v1 c18 P26](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0026), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011), [v3 c19 P3](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0003), [v3 c19 P20](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0020)_

## History

Paul Irving arrives in Avonlea from the United States to live with his grandmother on the shore road. At school, he rapidly becomes a favorite pupil of Anne Shirley, who recognizes him as a kindred spirit and a genius at creative thinking. Paul creates a world of imaginary 'rock people' on the beach, including Nora, the Golden Lady, and the Twin Sailors. He excels in his studies under Anne and Miss Stacy, competing admirably with older students. When his father, Stephen Irving, unexpectedly visits Avonlea, Paul introduces him to Anne, leading eventually to Stephen reuniting with his former love, Miss Lavendar Lewis. Paul warmly accepts Miss Lavendar as his 'Mother Lavendar.' After their wedding, Paul moves to Boston to live with his father and new mother, later travelling abroad for two years of study while publishing his own poetry.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011), [v3 c15 P1](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0001), [v3 c19 P2](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0002), [v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002), [v3 c28 P21](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0021), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c28 P23](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0023)_

## Quotes

> I’m not scared, but I’d rather have the light. My little mother used always to sit beside me and hold my hand till I went to sleep.  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

> The world looks like something God had just imagined for His own pleasure, doesn’t it?  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037)</sub>

> I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes... the look my little mother always had.  <sub>[v3 c19 P20](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0020)</sub>
